entities.name: Multiple myeloma
observations: Typical presentation includes anemia, hypercalcemia, renal impairment, and persistent bone pain (CRAB features).
An elevated total-protein-to-albumin gap supports a monoclonal immunoglobulin disorder but is not diagnostic alone.

source_tools.relevance: Clinical pattern and diagnostic reasoning from delegated biomedical search

entities.name: Myeloma confirmation
observations: Bone marrow biopsy demonstrating clonal plasma cells is the confirmatory diagnostic test for suspected multiple myeloma.
Serum protein electrophoresis detects or supports a monoclonal protein but does not by itself establish symptomatic myeloma.

source_tools.relevance: Comparison of confirmatory versus screening tests in suspected multiple myeloma
